summary: One query-key factory + useAppMutation wrapper + ESLint ban replace nine hand-written invalidations; optimistic cadastros writes, Atualizando affordance, and the wizard remount bug fixed.
oracle: CI=true pnpm --filter @fxl-sales/web exec vitest run src/lib/__tests__/app-mutation.test.ts src/sales-ops/__tests__/optimistic.test.ts src/sales-ops/__tests__/cadastros-refresh.test.tsx src/sales-ops/__tests__/sale-wizard-state-preservation.test.tsx
tests_changed: none - no existing test was modified. All four new test files are additive.
notes: Red observed before implementation: all 4 new files failed (2 on missing modules, 3 DOM assertions on the real bugs). Two of the five cadastros-refresh cases passed pre-implementation and are regression guards, not oracles: 'keeps exactly one row after the POST and the refetch' (cannot fail before an optimistic write exists; it guards against the new write duplicating rows) and 'shows a new produto once the POST resolves' (broad invalidation already covered it, matching the plan's Current state analysis). @tanstack/react-query 5.101.2 uses the 5-arg onSettled / 4-arg onError signature (onMutateResult plus MutationFunctionContext), so useAppMutation forwards all five args and the 4th generic is named TOnMutateResult; the plan's 4-arg sketch would not compile. Out of scope but noticed: apps/web/src/lib/api-client.ts:5 still shows an inline queryKey literal inside a docstring example.
